One of the biggest challenges in healthcare is diagnosing diseases accurately. AI-powered algorithms can analyze vast amounts of data to identify patterns and make predictions.
AI-powered chatbots are being used to help patients manage their conditions and improve their overall health.
Studies have shown that AI can improve patient outcomes by up to 30% and reduce healthcare costs by up to 20%.
